top_signals.title: Iranian Hardliners Call for Tanker Convoy to Defy U.S. Blockade
top_signals.summary: With Iran's revenue from crude oil and condensate exports projected to hit zero by mid-December, hardline commentators and outlets close to the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) are increasingly advocating a direct challenge to the US naval blockade of Iranian ports and waters. Their proposal is for a declared "convoy of tankers" to sail through the blockade, accompanied by threats to target the oil infrastructure of Iran's Gulf neighbors if US forces attack Iranian vessels.
